The 9/30 strategic digest from Moss gives the ticket as #8841. It says Mateo Quiroga submitted it about drivers at the Newark facility being unable to select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. You escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check the number before you send it to engineering. On July 1 in #strategic-pod you wrote that you'd closed #8841 with support. That was the Detention Summary export and kiosk-tablet cache issue, which is a different problem. Either the digest has the wrong number or the number was reused. I can't see the support system, so I can't tell which. Look up Mateo's Door 14 ticket there directly.

INC-4821 in #inc-vtg-hartford is something else. It's the Hartford status-page access issue from August 3, not Newark Door 14.
